summary: Defines the Signature Validation Token (SVT), which gives evidence that an electronic signature was valid. Signatures have limited lifetimes for validation, and a trusted authority issues an SVT to assert that a signature was successfully checked according to defined procedures. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Signature checks can expire as keys age. A trusted helper checks one and gives you a signed note saying it was good, so you can prove it later.

questions: what is a signature validation token
how to preserve proof that a signature was valid
